advice: No distinct, useful panel-layout change is established from the supplied evidence. The correctly sized 64 KiB A panel reused across 16 column panels matches the measured one-streaming-region layout; the 32 KiB version is too small. The supplied full B-panel packing and column-panel-first traversal were also measured and rejected. I abstain rather than relabel a measured layout.
risks: A new panel schedule could change packing cost, traversal, or SME transitions together, so its results may not isolate reuse. Any distinct candidate would need all allocation, packing, tail handling, and cleanup inside gemm, plus the fixed correctness checks and ten paired runs.
